reason: Conversation 1 asked exactly the right first questions (door/drawer closed, food condition), got the ajar-drawer root cause confirmed in one turn, and gave proportionate advice with no unsupported fault speculation. Conversation 2 reached the same correct 'temperature alarm' conclusion and usefully told the user to press the bell button and allow hours to recover, but its opener was an unfocused kitchen-sink list with US units, an unnecessary unplug reset, and gratuitous mentions of door switch/sensor/board faults, and it never actually confirmed the drawer cause. Conversation 1's weaknesses were omitting the alarm-off button and giving optimistic timings (beep stopping in minutes, recovery in 30-60 min), which keeps the margin slight.
